layman_headline: The crypto market is fearful and lacking clear setups — patience is the best trade right now.
layman_explanation: The overall crypto market is in a 'Fear' state with most major coins drifting slightly lower. The swing trade candidates today are either wildly overbought tokens that already surged 100%+ (too risky to chase), coins in freefall with no bottom in sight, or stablecoins that don't move. None of the setups present a compelling risk-reward entry with clear stop-losses. We're better off waiting for a cleaner opportunity.
layman_action: Stay in cash and watch. Don't chase pumps or try to catch falling knives. Wait for fear to peak and a quality coin to show a clear reversal signal before entering.
expert_reasoning: The candidate pool is extremely poor this cycle. AKE (RSI 87, +163% in 7d) and VELVET (+108% in 7d) are classic chase-the-pump traps with extreme correction risk. BEAT is down 69% in a week and 94% from ATH — a potential dead cat bounce but with zero technical data to confirm a bottom. UNI is down 19.5% weekly with no RSI data to confirm oversold conditions, and at -92.9% from ATH it may be in secular decline. SOL stands out with relative strength and institutional narrative support, but BTC dominance at 56.1% continues to pressure alts. The improving Fear & Greed trend (29→34) is encouraging but hasn't reached a level that historically precedes strong bounces. I'm HOLDING for a better setup.
risk_factors: BTC dominance at 56.1% continues to siphon capital from altcoins, making alt swing trades riskier
Fear & Greed at 34 is improving but could reverse if BTC breaks below $62K support
Most swing candidates lack RSI/MACD data making proper technical analysis impossible
watch_list: BTC price action around $62K-$63K — a break below $62K would signal further downside and delay any alt entries
Fear & Greed index — watch for continuation above 40 to confirm sentiment recovery before entering
SOL relative strength — if SOL holds above $73 while BTC weakens, it confirms leadership and a pullback to $72 becomes a high-conviction entry
market_context: The crypto market is in a fearful but slowly improving state. BTC at $63K with high dominance (56.1%) means capital is flowing to safety rather than alts, making swing trades on smaller coins particularly risky right now.
context_banner: Fear is improving but no actionable swing setups exist — capital preservation beats forced trades in this environment.

key_signals.description: Fear & Greed at 34 improving from 29 weekly average — sentiment thawing but not yet at contrarian buy levels (~20 or below).
AKE's RSI at 87.27 is deeply overbought, confirming the 163% 7-day rally is extended and high-risk to chase — our most reliable indicator says avoid.
Trump White House crypto CEO meeting and Israel's largest bank offering crypto trading are positive macro tailwinds, but haven't yet translated into price action.
'ETH derivatives reset' and 'Finding good news in spite of bad headlines' suggest the market may be near a bottom but confirmation is needed.
No meaningful volume breakouts detected among quality candidates — volume data unavailable for most swing candidates, reducing conviction.
